name: BeyondSky AI Writer
author: BeyondSky

sections.description:
Fill in a short brief, pay per article, and the finished articles arrive in this site as drafts.
Images are downloaded into your own Media Library, so nothing depends on an external host.

Articles are never published automatically. Everything arrives as a draft for you to review.

External services

This plugin connects to the UnlimitedVisitors API to price an order, take payment, and deliver the
finished articles.

  • Endpoint: https://api.unlimitedvisitors.io
  • Data sent when you submit the form: your email address, the keywords and options you entered,
    this site’s host name, and a random token generated by this plugin so the articles can be
    delivered back.
  • Data received: the generated articles and their image URLs.
  • Terms: https://unlimitedvisitors.io/terms
  • Privacy: https://unlimitedvisitors.io/privacy

Payment is processed by Stripe. You are redirected to Stripe Checkout to pay.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to AI Writer in the admin menu.
  3. Enter your email, choose how many articles you want, and give each one a keyword. A title is optional, leave it empty and we choose one.
  4. Set the language, article size, readability and tone, and add any details about your business you want woven in.
  5. Click Continue to payment. You pay per article through Stripe.
  6. The finished articles arrive in this site as drafts, with their images in your Media Library. Nothing is published automatically.
sections.faq:
Do the articles publish automatically?

No. Every article is inserted as a draft.

Where do the images go?

Into this site’s Media Library. The article HTML is rewritten to point at your local copies.

How long do the articles take?

Usually within 24 hours. We email you as soon as they land in your site.

Do I need an account?

No. You order and pay from inside WordPress, and the articles are delivered back to this site automatically.

What does it cost?

You pay per article, and the current price is shown on the AI Writer screen before you order. There is no subscription.
